photos/ ends with 2026-trip-001.jpg, 2026-trip-002.jpg and 2026-trip-003.jpg

evals.prompt: Use the memorize skill. In this repository the glossary says 'task' but I keep calling them 'tickets' and you keep mixing them up. Settle it: 'task' is the term, and it was chosen because the tracker already uses it.

expectations: The lesson is stated in one sentence with its reason
The home chosen is documentation/glossary.md, reached by calling document, not AGENTS.md
documentation/glossary.md is read first, and the existing Task entry is updated rather than a second Task entry added

No architecture decision record is written for an easily reversed choice

evals.prompt: Remember that I prefer short answers with no trailing summary, in every project.
evals.expected_output: A personal preference is filed in the harness's memory, or in ~/.agents/memory/ with an INDEX.md line, and not in any project file.

When ~/.agents/memory/ is used, INDEX.md gains exactly one line for it in the form '- [Title](file.md): when it applies'

The pointer tells agents to read .agents/scripts/INDEX.md before writing a script or a pipeline longer than one line
The pointer also tells agents to call memorize on a standing rule, a request to remember, a correction to how something is done, or a second rebuild
The second run reads AGENTS.md, finds the pointer, and does not add a second copy
